description: Expected output schema for the corrected and extended benchmarking analysis.

ert.description: Expected Running Time for each (algorithm, function, dimension, target) combination.
ert.value: float or null (null when no run reaches the target)

ecdf.description: Empirical CDF of runtimes for each (algorithm, dimension, budget) combination.

rankings.description: Algorithm rankings for each function group, ordered from best to worst.

scaling_exponents.description: Dimension-scaling exponent for each (algorithm, function) pair at the tightest target.
scaling_exponents.value: float or null (null when fewer than 2 dimensions have finite ERT)

vbs_ert.description: Virtual Best Solver ERT: minimum finite ERT across all algorithms for each scenario. Represents the oracle lower bound.
vbs_ert.value: float or null (null when no algorithm reaches the target)

algorithm_selection.description: Which algorithm achieves the VBS ERT for each scenario. Ties broken alphabetically.

performance_profile.description: Fraction of solvable scenarios where algorithm ERT is within tau times VBS ERT.
performance_profile.note: Only scenarios where at least one algorithm has finite ERT are counted in the denominator.
